body.statement: For every \(T\) and \(\beta\in\mathcal K\), the construction \(G_T(\beta)\) belongs to \(\mathcal H_T\), and \(p_{T,G_T(\beta)}\) has exact acceptance mass \(\alpha\) and support bounded below by \(\eta/|\Omega_T|\).
body.justification: The oracle comparator must itself be a legal positive-support exact-alpha design on every finite assignment support.
body.gap: The published raw oracle is an asymptotic quadratic criterion; legality under the present exact boundary randomization is an auxiliary finite-design obligation.
body.consumer: It ensures that every reported oracle contrast compares two implementable assignment distributions.
